acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce actual concurrent map replacement at the pre-lock read boundary without weakening safe-read checks.
Valid concurrent in-place marks serialize with all marks surviving; hostile input and explicit-output locking regressions still pass.
Retain original failure, focused regression evidence and independent review.
body: Observed final exact-target focused test at c7f7eed799aad9428b082578073f04c9715ac1f7, Go1.27.1, Darwin: TestConcurrentMarksAllSurvive failed workflow_test.go:522 with map-unavailable changed while being read. Actual check-002-0.log retained in the enrolled local-completion directory; baseline previously passed. Workflow code is unchanged from b234541d6022191d7906917d715664b5cac5cede. commands.go:579 reads the map before locking the effective output; an in-place concurrent atomic replacement can therefore refuse before serialization. Expected all 12 valid concurrent in-place marks succeed and survive. A passing retry does not erase this observed failure. No fix made in native S0E source.
title: Concurrent CEM marks can fail pre-lock map read during replacement
